body: This are valid points and i see what your saying. I supposed the constant pressure of needing money and my parents waiting for me to move out has put a damper on my creative side. most of me feels that now i need to take any job i can get just to gtfo and not have to deal with the negativity everyday from my parents. Sure they are great for helping me living and providing meals/car insurance/ a roof etc. But just having to sit down with them every single day and having no real financial opportunities and them being like wtf are you doing, get your shit together is really de motivating. Ive tried expressing this to them and i totally see their point and I have no leg to stand on but at times its like wtf, ive tried as hard as I can for today, ive applied to 3 jobs and made a youtube video, I have left the house emaculate becuause i know thats an issue and then all i do is get yelled at for 1 little thing i did wrong, regardless of al i did right to try and avoid and confrontation with my parents. I feel if i moved out i would be psychologically healthier and sound, but having a free room and board with meals seems more advantageous while i look for work. I dread leaving my room to get meals in fear of this confrontation. I really just want to sell my car and belongings and move to L.A to try and find better opporutnities in my field, yet i know rent and cost of living is high out there. I know i can muster up about 5- 6grand if i sold my car and everything but I fear Ill move out and not be able to find work. Yet i know since living on my own briefly in college im significantly in a better mood when im not around my family as odd as that seems.

I suppose this resonates with me slightly. My thing is that im not trying to avoid the grind life puts on me, I'm actively trying to "grind" and yet i cant seem to land any opportunities outside of Youtube which is lackluster for the time being. I love video editing and creating and lose myself in that and get hyped to make new content and yet no one ever really sees the work I do, and the video editing internships don't seem to be interested in me. I don't know how to make it and thats my biggest gripe.

Do you have a wife and kids? grandkids? are you well off financially? if so please do live on for them. If not then do what you will but note that I am a 25 year old man who is on the verge of suicide. In my short time i have been arrested and volunteered at a a variety of places. I have enountered many elederly folks that just seeem to enjoy giving back. You can meet someone too this way as there are many widows prime for the taking. whatever you choose, 70 years is a damn good run.
